property_title_example: Prime Agricultural Land for Sale in Al-Zabadani – 3 Dunams with Fruit Trees
description_example: A sprawling 3,000 square meter (3 Dunams) fertile plot located in the heart of the Al-Zabadani plain. The land is fully planted with mature apple and cherry trees and includes a licensed water well for irrigation. It features a flat terrain with easy 2nd-line access from the main road, making it ideal for a private orchard or a seasonal farmhouse. Legal status is a clean Green Tabou (2400 shares).
